content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket. Nancy Hunter (E038) requests admin access to Payroll.

The notes have conflicting information:
- HR, IT, Finance, Compliance say full_time Engineer → max write (since Engineer doesn't own Payroll, admin not allowed)
- Facilities says Engineer, full-time (per HR/IT/Finance/Compliance notes)
- Security says contractor, basic security training → max read

There's a conflict between HR/IT/Finance/Compliance (full_time) and Security (contractor).

The policy:
1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns the system.
2. contractor employees: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.

Payroll is owned by Payroll Specialist role. Engineer doesn't own Payroll.

If full_time: max write. Requested admin > max, grant write.
If contractor with basic training: max read. Requested admin > max, grant read.

Which to believe? Most notes (5 out of 6, with Facilities deferring to HR) say full_time. Security is the outlier. The majority consensus is full-time Engineer, so max is write.

So grant write.

Let me submit decision with write.
